title: Foreground authentication lease lifetime
behavior: Keep a prepared foreground broker alive while collector liveness exists; active monitors also prevent idle expiry; passive idle brokers still expire.
alternative: Apply idle timeout indiscriminately after ten minutes.
rationale: Main tip adds has_foreground_liveness to should_exit_idle and tests post-sleep/eleven-minute behavior. This is baseline behavior, not an optional branch feature.
tests: Clock jump + no provider call; active monitor; passive expiry; live foreground liveness after idle; owner termination.
risk: Crate extraction or sidecar fallback can accidentally sever the liveness owner.

title: Layered workspace and policy extractions
behavior: One coherent adapters/apps/core/services/testing/tools/ui graph with required features, runtime contracts and discoverable tests.
alternative: Mechanical merge of all 366 policy commits, or retaining flat and layered duplicate implementations.
rationale: The manifest confirms extensive leaf extraction but capped comparisons cannot prove every body/test is retained. Approve exact source units only after complete coverage.
tests: Metadata graph, per-package/feature catalog diff, policy/file-size/agent checks, source-to-result symbol review.
risk: Large move set, ownership/feature regressions, missing source tests.

title: Pinned Rust/MBX/Mise modernization
behavior: One reviewed toolchain and lockfile; retain missing modernization benefits including native-local task and release-preview behavior.
alternative: Prefer the newest timestamp or copy an old flat manifest over the selected graph.
rationale: T has two exclusive commits and four target commits missing; P moves the Rust floor to 1.99. File overlap alone does not prove equivalent intent.
tests: Pinned installation, metadata, dependency policy, native task contracts, release-preview fixture and lock reproducibility.
risk: Inconsistent pins, stale wrapper contracts and accidental dependency downgrade.

title: Exact credential capability binding
behavior: Exact account/surface/source/material fingerprint binding; fail closed for ambiguity, missing material and multiple candidate matches.
alternative: Broaden provider aliases or accept a matching display name as authority.
rationale: Inspected s7 functions carry security checks that may be obscured by extraction. Preserve their semantics and negative cases.
tests: Mixed env/profile, duplicate launch-key binding, mismatched fingerprint/source/account, closed alias-set and zero-call denial tests.
risk: Privilege expansion through permissive reconciliation.

title: Revoked account result-free uncertainty marker
behavior: Retain the concrete state store for the persisted marker assertion after replacing corrupt/revoked account state.
alternative: Lose the assertion by moving only the trait-object handle.
rationale: The tip directly fixes the test seam; compare the final policy test before adding a duplicate.
tests: corrupt_revoked_account_is_replaced_with_result_free_uncertainty_marker; inspect actual persisted state after catalog rotation.
risk: A passing coordinator test that no longer examines durable state.

title: Typed provider statuses and retry authority
behavior: Keep structured HTTP status and retry metadata through adapters; only typed 403 establishes Claude scope restriction.
alternative: Search arbitrary display strings for 401/403/429 or Retry-After-looking text.
rationale: The archived typed-error patch explicitly rejects misleading transport/CLI strings and distinguishes auth status from display precedence.
tests: Port 429 text; typed 403 with message mentioning 401; typed 401/429; transport/decode text; absent authoritative retry deadline.
risk: False authorization denial, fabricated rate deadlines or incorrect inference-only classification.

title: Claude session/weekly freshness and 100-percent remaining
behavior: Derive zero used from authoritative 100% remaining where supported; preserve independent window freshness and unknown reset values.
alternative: Fabricate a reset timestamp or make session fresh because weekly data is fresh.
rationale: U records a v12 fix but explicitly does not establish live acceptance. Adapt tested semantics, not its readiness claims.
tests: Per-window partial observations, missing used/reset, stale session with fresh weekly, bounded percent and synthetic zero-call fixtures.
risk: Misleading quota availability or fresh-looking stale data.

title: Observe-only monitor authority boundary
behavior: Observe-only monitors remain goal-less/non-runnable and do not grant, revoke or exercise task dispatch authority.
alternative: Treat monitor presence or an active broker as authorization.
rationale: The live handoff clearly separates observation from task policy and leaves dispatch unapproved.
tests: Observe-only goal_id/runnable output, no launch/auth/provider dispatch, absent/denied capabilities.
risk: Unattended activity against live credentials.

title: Monitor schema, wire and fingerprint migration
behavior: Reconcile U schema-6/wire-v9 requirements with selected versions; preserve stable binding and complete predecessor/recovery handling.
alternative: Blindly increment or downgrade schema integers or open real state to test.
rationale: Migration and wire shape span multiple new leaf crates; compatibility requires explicit mapping and fixture tests.
tests: All supported predecessors, interruption, malformed/ambiguous records, fingerprint stability, mixed-version rejection and recovery.
risk: Irreversible state changes or silently incompatible clients.

title: Bundled usage broker executable
behavior: A jackin package includes the intended broker sibling and correct shared service entry point; preserve diagnostic stderr context.
alternative: Assume a separately installed runtime sidecar exists.
rationale: The source adds a jackin binary target and shared service module specifically to avoid missing-sidecar installations.
tests: Fresh fixture prefix, both binary identities, missing/invalid executable and activation/argument error fixtures.
risk: Package works in checkout but fails after installation.

title: Missing-sidecar in-process fallback
behavior: Choose fallback only after preserving lease ownership, leader-election/CAS, capability isolation and client-lifetime semantics.
alternative: Always fail closed versus always enable fallback after any sidecar failure.
rationale: The source changes negative activation behavior. Main foreground liveness and current auth architecture require explicit safety proof before choosing it.
tests: Missing/unusable sidecar; uncreatable data dir; owner death; concurrent activation; no capability bypass.
risk: In-process lifetime weaker than sidecar lifetime; hiding a packaging/security error.

title: Permanent coordination inode extraction
behavior: Preserve permanent owned private regular coordination inodes, safe namespace placement and non-unlinking lock release.
alternative: Assume the crate name in P proves all stash code/tests/untracked files were incorporated.
rationale: The stash contains specific path/ownership/link-count safeguards. Every parent payload must be reconciled.
tests: Prunable overlap, parent/symlink traversal, missing/permission ambiguity, wrong owner/mode/type/link count, cleanup and lock release.
risk: Lock identity substitution or pruning active authority.

title: Repo-cache lock and identity extraction
behavior: Retain reentrant RepoLock and per-path last-handle semantics; audit host-aware repository identity against the selected contract.
alternative: Copy host-stripping repo_matches behavior without security/compatibility review.
rationale: Inspected code normalizes owner/repo across URL forms, raising an identity question that requires actual destination comparison.
tests: Nested same-process handles, different paths, blocking-pool acquisition/cancellation, same owner/repo on different hosts.
risk: Wrong cached repository reuse or lock lifetime regressions; not a confirmed exploit from inspection alone.

title: Purge absence guard extraction
behavior: Preserve ensure_absent_for_purge_with preconditions and failure behavior in the final cleanup-absent-guards owner.
alternative: Add back intermediate jackin-runtime-apple-container-ensure-absent solely to match an archived path.
rationale: P manifest uses the cleanup-absent-guards leaf; s61 documentation records a prior intermediate extraction and unverified old quality results.
tests: Guard outcomes, interrupted purge, live/container ambiguity and unchanged test identities.
risk: Safety checks lost during rename or stale baseline claims accepted as current.

title: Model/effort CLI-to-runtime propagation
behavior: Validate model/effort and propagate them through dry-run, launch and restore while preserving old JSON fields.
alternative: Keep only the parser/help or duplicate historical propagation paths.
rationale: The reflog snapshot adds CLI behavior; historical build-split records identify complementary runtime propagation.
tests: Trimmed/empty model, four effort values, invalid effort, defaults/null JSON, actual launch/restore selection.
risk: Accepted-but-ignored user options or restored sessions selecting the wrong agent.

title: OMP/config/restore durability obligations
behavior: Locate and verify final destinations for OMP/WAL snapshot, stored agent identity, config migration/proof and durable cleanup obligations.
alternative: Assume all historical open issues remain present, or that the old squash message proves they are all fixed.
rationale: Archived reports give concrete tests and rejected intermediates but are not current test results.
tests: Concurrent writer snapshot, WAL reset suffix, interruption/fsync cleanup, migration golden/ambiguity fixtures, proof invalidation and source discovery.
risk: Reopening fixed work or silently losing still-missing persistence/security behavior.

title: Per-request diagnostic retry assertions
behavior: Each retry must carry one matching log event, not merely a correct flattened total.
alternative: Accept a 0/1/2 split over three requests because its sum is three.
rationale: The sanitized patch directly strengthens wire_failure_support assertions.
tests: Negative 0/1/2 distribution and positive 1/1/1; traces/logs/metrics request counts.
risk: Retry-payload corruption concealed by aggregate counts.

title: Privacy, TLS and connection-choice tests after splitting
behavior: Retain no-private-value OTLP assertions, TLS feature guard and invalid connection-choice tests in the selected split modules.
alternative: Treat removal from an old test file as either proof of loss or proof of harmless relocation.
rationale: The source snapshots show large test-module moves and historical rejected redaction intermediates.
tests: Per-assertion catalog map, payload inspection, TLS compile/feature cases, rejected endpoint choices.
risk: Security regressions hidden by structural test churn.

title: Durable push-head CI evidence qualification
behavior: Keep explicit obligations and schema-5 predecessor, completed-run, artifact-byte/hash and workflow/Git binding proofs.
alternative: Observed-run-only denominator, fixture-derived green status or unbound success-like conclusions.
rationale: The ledger and hardening sources deliberately make missing/conflicting/unqualified evidence fail closed.
tests: Missing producer, missing predecessor, wrong before SHA, mismatched workflow/tree/digest, partial status, fixture and conflicting terminal observations.
risk: False-green reliability or stale evidence reused across heads.

title: First-parent-only post-merge denominator
behavior: Use Git first-parent history as repository evidence, not as proof of which push heads produced workflow obligations.
alternative: 12dea6c5 first-parent model versus durable push-head/artifact model at 14bd1471.
rationale: The stronger source candidate proves actual event grouping; negative fixtures/conflict handling from the first-parent candidate still merit retention. This is a proposed design supersession, not proof it is already integrated.
tests: Multi-commit push represented by one workflow head; gaps and fixture inputs stay unqualified.
risk: Counting obligations for commits that were never distinct push heads, or missing true unstarted obligations.

title: Installer-wide sccache/backend activation
behavior: Do not enable RUSTC_WRAPPER/GHA backend globally before installation.
alternative: Global shared-workflow environment versus task-scoped guarded successor.
rationale: The inspected source exports wrapper settings before setup; successor 41dd148e explicitly confines them. Current selected cache policy may remove the wrapper altogether.
tests: Installer env clean; absent wrapper/backend does not fake validation; current cache contract tests.
risk: Bootstrap failures and unprovisioned/global backend assumptions.

title: Tool wrapper isolation and provisioning contracts
behavior: Retain installer isolation and guarded backend availability checks where applicable to the selected toolchain.
alternative: Restore old sccache workflows merely to preserve their literal string assertions.
rationale: The successor improves scope but contains tool-dependent smoke skips and old generated contract assumptions.
tests: Provision-before-use, wrapper absence, endpoint/token availability, actual executed smoke count.
risk: Stale tests forcing obsolete architecture or early-return passes misreported as validation.

title: Native product graph and full Apple obligations
behavior: Keep one producer-consumer XCFramework graph, profile/floor, harnesses, UI count proof, stamping, dSYM and native format/lint/dead-code gates.
alternative: Duplicate synthetic Swift units or a partial generic migration that drops task-owned obligations.
rationale: Several archived candidates preserve different portions of native generation; selected P/T native Mise flow must carry the complete contract.
tests: Fresh native build, correct producer paths, CI/merge/scheduled commands and macOS OrbStack release lane.
risk: Swift resolves a missing/wrong product or validates fewer behaviors after migration.

title: Intentionally unregenerated pre-M1 state
behavior: Do not integrate mismatched new inputs and old generated outputs.
alternative: 8fb49688 inputs-only snapshot versus complete later generation plus current selected contract.
rationale: The commit explicitly expects policy --check to fail and says not to land before M1 regeneration.
tests: Byte-identical generation from the final reviewed input tree and selected generator product.
risk: Known-invalid CI state entering main.

title: WIP musl/GNU tool lock mappings
behavior: Regenerate and validate supported platform mappings instead of copying saved lock rows.
alternative: Hand-retain linux-musl aliases pointing at GNU binaries.
rationale: The patch shows those mappings but planning did not execute platform compatibility checks.
tests: Platform-specific resolution, checksums/signatures and actual binary/runtime compatibility.
risk: Wrong libc/architecture artifact selected by an apparently valid lock.

title: Zig minisign provenance
behavior: Preserve verified minisign provenance when producing the selected lockfile.
alternative: Drop provenance while reconciling platform changes.
rationale: The saved lock explicitly adds a provenance field. Keeping a field is conditional on valid generated/signature evidence.
tests: Pinned tool signature/provenance and reproducible lock generation.
risk: Supply-chain evidence silently weakened.

title: Staged-only affected-crate selection
behavior: Select the union of HEAD↔index and index↔worktree dependency changes; widen safely on structural/parse ambiguity.
alternative: Compare only HEAD to working tree and miss staged-only changes.
rationale: Inspected source and tests address staged changes even when working bytes are reverted to HEAD.
tests: Comment-only no-op, staged version/structure changes, two-pair union, either-pair parse failure.
risk: Pre-commit checks silently skip affected crates.

title: Preserved test identities through policy splits
behavior: Preserve assertion-level coverage while splitting large tests and adjusting imports/helpers.
alternative: Trust total test counts or file-presence alone.
rationale: Comparison responses are capped and some moved-file stats are zero despite actual content.
tests: Per-package/feature/test identity map, body review, actual nonzero selection and platform disposition.
risk: False confidence from inflated counts or undetected orphan modules.

title: Proof-only production debris
behavior: Exclude inspected hook-proof functions, duplicate definitions, cache comments, empty probe commits and malformed untracked production source.
alternative: Merge every archived tip regardless of intentional test damage.
rationale: Visible patches/messages identify proof-only or deliberately malformed payloads. This rejection does not cover unseen history or parent trees.
tests: Isolated hook/stale-head/cache regression fixtures; no probe debris in final source.
risk: Accidentally rejecting useful ancestral changes along with a probe tip.

title: Whole synthetic conflict snapshot
behavior: Do not merge the fea3ade unresolved conflict tree or infer historical ancestry from its synthetic parent.
alternative: Wholesale import to preserve every byte.
rationale: The source explicitly disclaims buildability; useful individual hunks remain separately subject to salvage review.
tests: Per-conflict-side audit, meaningful hunk dispositions and no unintended merge markers.
risk: Broken source and fabricated history entering the integration.

title: Historical evidence and operating records
behavior: Retain provenance, rejected alternatives and unresolved obligations with accurate dates and verification scope.
alternative: Convert historical run claims into present PASS or overwrite current commands with obsolete paths.
rationale: The records contain important constraints but reference other hosts, older revisions and pending live actions.
tests: Link/source SHA checks, exact current task commands and NOT_RUN/live distinction.
risk: An executable runbook accidentally performs a live cutover or claims unearned readiness.

title: Sanitized audit tip with no returned patch
behavior: Inspect actual tree/parents and retained documentation before closing the source.
alternative: Infer the entire branch is empty from null diff/files.
rationale: Only metadata is available for the sanitized tip; the missing-patch condition is a specific evidence gap.
tests: Tree equality, parent comparison, direct target diff and historical documentation closure.
risk: Sanitized or empty-looking tips concealing meaningful ancestry.

title: Strict warm CI and flaky-test accounting
behavior: Preserve documented offline fan-out, exact semantic cache keys, canonical writer, first-attempt accounting, shrink-only quarantine and warm one-minute contract.
alternative: Inflate timeouts, broaden cache reuse or conceal reruns to claim success.
rationale: Pinned P TESTING.md states these requirements, but no planning run established achieved timing.
tests: Cold/exact-warm/changed-source/changed-contract runs, forbidden download/build markers, retry/quarantine and per-job timing evidence.
risk: Performance or correctness degraded under a superficially faster cache.
